user.title: Toyota Connected Services
user.description: Enter the username and password for your Toyota or Lexus account.

otp.title: Verification code
otp.description: Check your email or phone for the verification code.

error.sso_account: Apple, Google, and Facebook sign-in are not supported. Sign out of the Toyota app and sign in with the same email address that Apple, Google, or Facebook uses, then tap Forgot password to set a password. Sign in here with that email and password.

init.title: Vehicle status updates
init.description: Home Assistant always reads Toyota's cloud data. That data stays unchanged until the vehicle contacts Toyota. Choose Cloud updates only to skip scheduled wakes. Refresh Status and remote commands stay available.
